external_rule: Freeze all configurations before MOT20 evaluation. Do not tune on MOT20 or reuse MOT17-11/13 as unseen data.

missed_people.FN_diagnostic_accounting: 100% of CLEAR FN explained by cache/GT overlap categories

identity.black_frame: All confirmed IDs before one black frame return on the repeated static-image clip; reject invalid GMC warps; new scene does not reuse IDs

speed.required: Detection/tracking/decode/drawing/export timing and separate fast/quality profiles. 30 FPS is reported separately, never inferred from playback FPS.

generalization.required: Baseline and frozen V2 scored on the same previously unused MOT20 windows; document checkpoint training-overlap uncertainty

application.required: Actual local upload, one-worker inference queue, accurate progress, preview, downloads, errors, cancellation, restart handling and end-to-end verification

selection_rule: Among development candidates satisfying FN and FP targets without HOTA/IDF1 loss, prefer fewer ID switches then highest HOTA. If none qualify, preserve the Pareto improvements and mark unmet criteria failed or partial; never relax these targets after measurement.
